name: cloudscope
description: CloudScope 运维大脑 MCP server — the ops/diagnosis tool surface for Huawei Cloud services behind one intranet endpoint (~248 callable tools). Covers alarms (CMA history/current/active), topology (SmartTopo EFS, MNet), metrics (CMX/CES tenant + basic + aggregation), DWS diagnosis + autopilot, RDS/DRS, ModelArts pools/training/inference, OBS bucket/QoS/policy, CMDB hosts + repair records, remediation diagnosis trees (list/start/trace), DecisionX diagnosis tasks, incident tickets (CIM/GOCM/warroom), CDN digital-ops, TROS node inspection over SSH, command risk scoring (oreo), and 云战地助手 knowledge search. No authentication required — the cloudscope route on the proxy is auth-free. Usable by any MCP-capable agent (load the bundled config) or any agent with Bash + Python 3 (run the bundled wrapper script).

network.note: The endpoint is on the Huawei intranet. It must bypass the corporate HTTP proxy (proxyuk.huawei.com:8080) or the connection fails. The wrapper script uses an explicit no-proxy opener automatically; when loading the MCP config into an agent, ensure NO_PROXY includes 100.93.18.106.

tools_note: One server, ~248 callable tools. This manifest intentionally does NOT embed the tool list (it rots: the server adds tools continuously — e.g. test stubs appear/disappear). For discovery use: (a) the dated snapshot in tools/inventory-2026-09-03.json (name + description each, offline browsable), or (b) the live server via the wrapper's list/search/schema subcommands (authoritative).

tools_summary.monitor_*: alarms by csn/instance/ip/time (CMA), SmartTopo topology (incl. EFS clusters), MNet AI diagnosis + root cause, CMX/CES metric data (tenant/basic/aggregation; CDC limits: 20000 rows, 3 days back)
tools_summary.tros_*: TROS ops platform: instances/nodes/traces, create+fetch diagnosis tasks, MRS cluster inspection over SSH (zgrep logs, du, ps, df/mem/CPU), Kafka/RabbitMQ topology, DMS backlog, APIGW authorization, AI agent task execution
tools_summary.opstools_*: DWS diagnosis items/execute/results, DLF job analysis, Ascend Brain node diagnosis, SOP command extraction
tools_summary.rds_*: DRS task instances/logs/jobs, alarm info, node page query, region list
tools_summary.dws_* + modelarts_*: DWS autopilot metrics/host overview/clusters; ModelArts pools, nodes, training jobs (+failure diagnosis, log preview, metrics), inference services/instances
tools_summary.obs_*: bucket location/QoS/IAM+VPCEP policies, access-log filter tasks, CAC scripts, generic DB queries
tools_summary.resources_*: CMDB host/PM details, EVS/ECS capacity, repair/fault records
tools_summary.cloud_auto_remediation_*: diagnosis trees: list by id/name/tag, start jobs, execution records by alarm csn, trace results, affected tenants, check items
tools_summary.decision_x_copilot_*: DecisionX diagnosis tasks: list/show, conclusions, log diagnosis, network-brain root cause
tools_summary.ommgmt_* / gom_* / cor_*: incident tickets (CIM), GOCM tickets + SOP details, warroom impact analysis
tools_summary.c_cdn_*: CDN digital-ops: nodes, risk metrics, inspections, cutover, quality reports, change tickets
tools_summary.misc: COA audit logs, oreo command-risk scoring, SOP-consistency models, 云战地助手 knowledge search, a few test stubs (zjc_test, ai_func2_*)
